decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered location plan, 258/PP/001a, 258/PP/002, 258/PP/003, Noise Impact Assessment, proof shield spec, 258/PP/004a
Received: 20/05/2025
Odour Risk Assessment REV B, kitchen extract ESP range, sitesafe carbon filters
Received: 30/09/2025].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Delivery & Servicing Plan (including details of vehicle movements, times that servicing shall take place and waste provision) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

The details shall accord with current guidance such as that issued by TfL and include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements (physical as well as managerial) for the servicing, including refuse collection, of all aspects of the development, the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles and a timetable for implementation. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to any variation.

Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 4 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which this permission refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the plant operate. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard 4142. An alternative position for assessment/measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved. 

b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter. 

c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ASHP, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review. If the plant fails to meet the specified standard, remedial measures shall be put in place immediately and the noise assessment shall be carried out again. This shall be repeated until the assessment has reached the required standard. Once achieved, the plant shall be maintained permanently 
Condition : 5 - The scheme of extract ventilation shall be fully installed as shown on the approved plans and specifications, and as detailed in the submitted Odour Risk Assessment by 'DustScanAD, dated 30th September 2025, Ref: ZDASSRH_AO_RevB_Final, before the system hereby approved is first brought into use and shall be maintained as specified thereafter and in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by odour during cooking activities at the premises.
Condition : 6 - Cleaning, servicing and maintenance of the approved extract odour control system shall be carried out in accordance with the schedule provided in Section 6.2 of the Odour Risk Assessment by 'DustScanAD, dated 30th September 2025, Ref: ZDASSRH_AO_RevB_Final at all times. The approved details shall be implemented prior to first use/operation and thereafter be permanently retained. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by smell and odour during cooking activities at the premises.
Condition : 7 - Use of the commercial kitchen extraction system shall not be permitted between the hours of 19:00 to 10:00 Mondays to Sundays. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from operation of the kitchen extraction system.   
Condition : 8 - Prior to commencement of the development, the sound insulation of the floor/ceiling separating the ground floor commercial unit and first floor dwelling shall be installed in accordance with the design specification detailed in document 258/PP/003 of the planning documents. Approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development and thereafter be permanently retained. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the adjoining noise sensitive premises is not adversely affected by noise.
description: Installation of a hot air extraction system to the shop.
